audit.why: Howling Gale (Q, hold-to-charge knockup), Zephyr (W, passive MS + slow), Eye of the Storm (E, shield), and Monsoon (R, knockback+heal) are all named correctly and the interactions (Q interrupts the W-Q engage, W kites out of range, R reverses the all-in) match the kit text.

edits.after: Monsoon's heal-over-time sustains Janna's duo through chip damage in extended fights — buy Grievous Wounds before you commit or your poke gets outhealed.
